title: Reward Hacking Detection via Behavioral Fingerprinting Across Prompt Paraphrases

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A black-box detection method for reward hacking is useful, but the link from inconsistency detection to actionable intervention is indirect. The method may produce false positives from legitimate prompt sensitivity.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Generating paraphrases with an LLM and measuring response consistency uses standard NLP tools. No training required, just inference and comparison. Accessible for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: consistency metrics across paraphrases for models at different RLHF stages. However, accessing models at various RLHF training stages requires either training or finding published checkpoints.
